metadata.title: Modern Country Portrait with Geometric Monogram

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, intimate portrait of a musician with an acoustic guitar, featuring a heavy geometric monogram and stacked sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a woman with dark curly hair and a blonde streak, holding an acoustic guitar. The lighting is warm and domestic, with a large, bold geometric monogram in the upper left and a two-line title in the lower right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed at the viewer
Guitar body anchoring the lower left quadrant
Monogram balanced against the title in opposite corners
Warm interior tones contrasting with dark denim clothing
coreInvariants: Geometric monogram composed of thick horizontal and diagonal bars
Acoustic guitar held in a resting position

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large geometric monogram in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the monogram in the top left, down the arm to the guitar, then up to the subject's face, ending at the title in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Occupied by the blurred interior background and the dark denim of the jacket.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers in the background and guitar wood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo and charcoal from the denim jacket.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale cream/white from the hair streak and title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Medium saturation with a focus on warm mid-tones and deep shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Condensed proportions for the artist name
Wide, open counters for the title text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Artist name features elongated vertical strokes
Title text features a diagonal 'W' with overlapping strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, abstract geometric mark paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric structure of the title text.
Provides the necessary geometric weight for the monogram elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned indoor portrait of a woman with curly dark hair and a blonde streak, wearing a denim jacket and holding an acoustic guitar. The background should be a soft-focus interior with amber lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy geometric monogram in the top left corner using thick black bars. Place a two-line stacked sans-serif title in the bottom right corner in a light cream color with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the monogram in the top left corner?
Is the title stacked in the bottom right?
Does the subject have a visible blonde streak in her hair?
Is the lighting warm and domestic?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the guitar in the frame
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title text
Exact tattoo designs on the arm
Specific brand logos on the guitar
postGenerationChecks: Check for clear eye contact from the subject
Ensure the monogram does not obscure the face
Verify the title text is legible against the dark jacket
Confirm the guitar is rendered with realistic wood textures
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Musician) + Instrument (Guitar) + Geometric Icon (Top Left) + Stacked Sans-Serif (Bottom Right) + Warm Interior Lighting.
